_readme: Fill this file yourself. Do NOT put API keys or secrets here (AdMob ids are not secrets). The BUILD decides the ads: the 'release' build of the GitHub workflow always shows the REAL ads below, the 'debug' build always shows Google TEST ads. 'useTestAds' only matters for builds not made by the workflow (flutter run on a computer).
_build_note: shrinkCode=false turns R8 off (safe). Set true only after the Android Smoke Test passes with the keep rules.
